meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入产品链接或脚本文案,自动生成宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你想把产品链接快速变成一支宣传视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link or script into a promo video.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn your product page into a promo video.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把产品链接、粘贴的脚本或简报变成一部产品发布/推广视频:先确认简报并创建项目,随后依次捕获网站素材、选定设计风格、撰写故事板和脚本、逐帧生成画面,最后渲染成 mp4 视频文件。
howto.when: 当用户想营销、发布或推广某个产品时触发;收到任何商业链接时默认走此流程。网站导览或展示类请求也适用,意图不明确则转 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这个产品的官网链接做成发布视频
say.note: 会走完整的产品发布视频流程

say.text: 用这段脚本来做我们的 SaaS 宣传片

say.text: 把我们的网站做成导览展示视频
say.note: 会以网站原貌截图为基础制作展示

howto.what_en: Claude turns a product/marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a launch/promo video: it confirms the brief, creates the project, captures assets, picks a design preset, writes storyboard/script, builds frames, and renders an mp4.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to market, launch, or promote a product, or gives any commercial URL; site tour/showcase requests also route here. Unclear intents go to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Make a launch video from this product's website link.
say_en.note: Runs the full product-launch video flow.

say_en.text: Use this script for our SaaS promo video.
say_en.note: Generates storyboard and video from the script.

say_en.text: Turn our website into a tour/showcase video.
say_en.note: Uses real site screenshots as the base.
